envelope.summary: The 8-task DAG covers all 16 requirements and has no cycles. Shared contracts (domain types, tokens, components, cell-name) come before the tasks that use them, and file scopes do not overlap. Every leaf has an explicit contract and named checks. Three non-blocking notes are about verification wording and how complete the requirement tags are.

findings.problem: TASK-04, 05, 06, 07 and 08 each state in `acceptance` that their CSS file (base.css, components.css, Board.css, panels.css, App.css) contains no literal color, size or spacing value. No task lists an executable check for this in `verification`. AC-16's planned evidence is only `tokens-usage-review`, so this part of REQ-13 relies on manual review.
findings.expected_fix: Have TASK-04 own one test (for example in src/ui/theme.test.ts or a styles test) that scans every src/ui/**/*.css file for literal values, measured against the allow-list in docs/DESIGN.md. Then name that test in the verification of TASK-05 to TASK-08 so CSS added later is checked automatically.

findings.problem: Several tasks do work for requirements they do not list. TASK-07 builds the turn-change transition (part of REQ-12) but its requirement_ids omit REQ-12. TASK-06, 07 and 08 build screens that must use the tokens (REQ-13) but do not list REQ-13. Coverage is still complete through TASK-04, 05 and 06, but the traceability is weaker than it should be.
findings.expected_fix: Add REQ-12 to TASK-07, and add REQ-13 to TASK-06, TASK-07 and TASK-08.

findings.problem: TASK-08 says the useComputerTurn effect "depends on roundId and phase". The effect also reads board, turn, difficulty, random, dispatch and thinkingMs. eslint.config.mjs:2,15 loads eslint-plugin-react-hooks and the project requires zero lint warnings, so declaring only those two dependencies would likely fail `npm run check`.
findings.expected_fix: Reword the contract so the effect declares every value it reads. The roundId guard in the reducer and the timer cleanup already prevent stale moves.

checked_criteria: Digest consistency: plan and spec identity come from the same snapshot (spec_digest 739f266b…, plan_digest 8e96d9ed…); no mismatch was supplied
Coverage both ways: every one of REQ-1..REQ-16 maps to at least one task with a named verification; every task carries requirement IDs

DAG integrity: there are no cycles and every depends_on points to an existing task. TASK-01 and TASK-04 are the roots. Critical path: TASK-01 -> TASK-03 -> TASK-07 -> TASK-08 (TASK-04 -> TASK-05/06 feeds into TASK-07)

Shared contracts come before the tasks that use them: board/lines/difficulty (TASK-01) before computer/session/Board; tokens (TASK-04) before components and screens; cell-name.ts (TASK-06) before RoundStatus (TASK-07)
parallel_safe_with pairs: no file_scope overlap among any declared parallel pairs (01/04, 01/05, 02/03..07, 03/04..06, 05/06)

Lockfile and public API: no task touches package.json or the lockfile; src/main.tsx and index.html belong only to TASK-04; src/ui/App.tsx and App.test.tsx belong only to TASK-08 (the placeholder exists at src/ui/App.tsx:4)
Leaves can be executed: each has explicit output signatures, observable acceptance, named test cases and an estimate of 30-45 minutes

Difficulty labels match controller_difficulty; there are no easy leaves; the hard leaf TASK-03 has an 'indivisible:' reason that holds up (one discriminated union for the session state and its invariants) and its contract is fully written out
Over-decomposition: no test-only tasks, no empty file_scope, no pair that one executor would obviously finish together within the target
Vertical integration: the domain is connected to the UI through component-level tasks and joined in TASK-08; acceptable at this feature's size

Completeness: no data or migrations in scope; DESIGN.md is created; the error paths (occupied cell, move after the round ends, stale computer move) have tests; the 360 px layout and screenshots are left to the controller's FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE stage
Future needs: the F2 RoundResult is committed_next and recorded as a constraint on TASK-03 and TASK-08; no hypothetical work is planned
Repo facts: src/domain/.gitkeep, src/main.tsx, index.html and the placeholder App exist; ENGINEERING.md limits (complexity ≤10, ≤60 lines per function) match the eslint config
limitations: Findings from round 1 were not supplied, so finding IDs could not be matched to earlier rounds.
Whether the 360 px layout, the 44 px touch targets and the visual quality are met cannot be checked from the plan; they rely on the screenshot evidence at FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.
Whether a tool is configured for the reduced-motion and contrast checks beyond the planned theme.test was not checked.

per_task.notes: Clear domain contract; tests for all 8 lines, draw, occupied cell and move after round end.
The three strategies follow Q-4; AC-1, AC-9 and AC-19 are each mapped to a named test; exhaustive check in both starting orders.
Hard leaf with a convincing 'indivisible:' reason; full action and transition contract; covers starter alternation, locking, stale roundId and JSON round trip.
DESIGN.md and tokens come before any screen; contrast and reduced-motion are tested. See DR-1 for the CSS literal check.
Small shared component contract with keyboard and disabled-state tests.
Roving tabindex, no wrap at edges, aria-disabled and cell names are all in AC-20 and AC-13 tests.
Props-only screens; live region and status text tested. See DR-2 for the missing REQ-12 tag.
Integration task with keyboard-only round, fake-timer pause and stale-move tests. See DR-3 for the hook's dependency wording.
